## Full negative answer

The explicit eleven-vertex tree has L(2,1) ordinary initial-segment palette size 5 and arbitrary-list number 6. Its conventional zero-based ordinary span is 4. Edge labels differ by at least 2 and distance-two labels must be distinct. This disproves Kohl's stated universal tree-equality conjecture under its original arbitrary-list quantifiers.

The complete authored construction and proof are retained: the five-vertex spine with six leaves, the A/B five-element lists, the short contradiction in both orientations, the explicit ordinary labeling and lower bound, and a self-contained Delta+3 arbitrary-list greedy upper bound. The infinite pendant-path family and the one-way rank-compression principle are also proved in full. No mathematical correction was required by the independent audit.

## Source conventions and scope

[Kohl's OWR Report 7/2006](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2006/07), printed pp. 414–416, states Conjecture 4 using arbitrary lists and the common ordinary palette {1,...,k}. The [2006 dissertation](https://webdoc.sub.gwdg.de/ebook/dissts/Freiberg/Kohl2006.pdf), printed p. 124, confirms chi=lambda+1 and repeats Conjecture 4.4. Its proved special families do not include this maximum-degree-3, radius-3 caterpillar with four degree-three vertices. The [ordinary-span algorithm paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/0810.0906) is not treated as an all-list theorem.

This AI-assisted manuscript is unrefereed. Acceptance records an independent internal AI audit, not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. No novelty, priority, minimality or current-openness claim is made.

## Proof and evidence boundary

Exactly eight authored prose and public-metadata files are added under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30000418. The full explicit mathematical construction and full nine-part logical audit remain inspectable. Raw state and Hall-certificate datasets, enumeration tables, executable code, copied source documents/text/images, and private coordination material are omitted.

Historical independent exact enumerators and certificate checks corroborate the written proof. Saved independent outputs are byte-identical across normal Python, -O and -OO. Candidate outputs differ only in the explicit optimization field. Historical finite checks do not replace the arbitrary-list proof and cannot be reproduced from this edition alone. Hashes authenticate bytes and recorded matches, not mathematical truth. No mathematical programs or new scholarly-source retrieval/inspection were run during preparation.

QUEUE.md and every existing repository path remain unchanged. Draft only; no merge, release, DOI or CI-pass claim.
